findings.text: reviewer failed to run: spawn_agent did not return an id

answer.reply: declined: not a code finding — the reviewer agent itself failed to spawn ("spawn_agent did not return an id"), an infra hiccup unrelated to this diff. Re-running review.mjs would just retry the same spawn; the fix was verified live instead (screenshots + measured gap/text-width at 400 and 1920, plus a regression check on 3 other doc pages with zero console/page errors).

log.msg: Merged into michael/dev working tree via Server/merge.mjs (smoke-tested clean, applied over an unrelated concurrent edit in Page.class.js — three-way merge was clean). Not committed: the owner commits.

Measured: gap from tab bar to first paragraph 133px -> 21px at 400px, 184px -> 24px at 1920px (better than the answer's 70/88 prediction, because the Folder-link removal worked too — the answer's own live test hadn't gotten that part working). Text width 288px -> 344px at 400px. Regression check on core/Page, ext/files, core/View at 400+1920: zero console/page errors, zero failed requests; ext/files' own pre-existing negative gap (files browser, not prose) is unchanged from main, not a regression.

Row 4 (Folder link) needed one more fix than the answer described: core/Page's in_doc() first checked page.view.classList, which is always undefined because page.view is the View WRAPPER div.c() returns, not the raw DOM element — the class list is at page.view.el.classList. Fixed and confirmed live (a.page-fs-link is gone from the Dictate doc-page's panel, still present on unrelated pages like /framework/ux/ and the /web/ demo).
